## Branch integration
Use `area/<domain>` → `main` with merge commit, and retain/sync the source area branch. Do NOT merge if the PR includes unfinished work. Record conflicts and required cross-domain approvals.

## Issue and area
Closes # (or explain why not yet filed).
Area: frontend / backend / data / AI / infra / docs / security.

## What changed and what remains out of scope

## Contract / privacy / security impact
- [ ] No case contents, secrets or PII committed
- [ ] Unknown remains unknown; no fabricated verification
- [ ] Contracts and consumers tested if changed

## Evidence
Commands actually run:
- [ ] API tests
- [ ] Synthetic evals
- [ ] Lint / typecheck
- [ ] Build
- [ ] Manual smoke test / screenshot when UI changed

## Risks, limitations, rollback

## Implementation vs vision
State which features are actually working, mocked or still blocked.
